item.title: No Man's Sky kicks off its tenth anniversary year with customisable trucks, hauling, and... gravity guns!
item.description: And here we go again! Barely a month into 2026, developer Hello Games is back with another major update for No Man's Sky, kicking off its tenth anniversary year in style. Assuming your idea of style is trucking, hauling, and tossing stuff around with gravity guns. that is (it's certainly mine). Read more

item.title: An hour with Pokopia suggests it might be the best Pokémon spin-off ever - and it's more Viva Pinata than Minecraft or Animal Crossing
item.description: When Pokopia was announced, most people drew a couple of quick comparative conclusions from its first cutesy trailer. There was much to be said in reaction, but the broad deduction can be efficiently summarised as this: Pokopia is Pokémon's take on Animal Crossing. It quickly transpired, also, that the game shares development staff with Dragon Quest Builders, a Minecraft-inspired spin-off of another major turn-based Japanese role-playing franchise. Read more

item.title: Arc Raiders sets new two-week PvE event, encourages players to be nice to each other
item.description: Arc Raiders has been around long enough now to have a "subculture" of its own. For the most part, millions of players have swarmed into Embark Studios' hit extraction shooter because most raiders found topside are... surprisingly nice. So far, the developers have been fostering a welcoming community even if PvP is an option, and the new event is all about experimenting with PvE further. Read more

item.title: Until Dawn and The Quarry developer announces new release date for sci-fi horror Directive 8020
item.description: Supermassive Games' Lashana Lynch-starring survival horror Directive 8020 has landed itself a new release date. Read more

item.title: After cutting half of 2XKO's team less than 30 days from launch, I have to ask: how can any of us get behind a new Riot game ever again?
item.description: Riot Games is "downsizing" a substantial number of developers from the team that has been working on 2XKO, the fighting game that only launched less than a month ago. Roughly 80 staff will be either transferred to other teams at Riot, or laid off with six months' severance pay. Read more

item.title: Hellraiser: Revival gets a new "love story" trailer just in time for Valentine's Day
item.description: Last summer, we were promised the first-ever Hellraiser video game somehow wasn't an asymmetrical online multiplayer one. Instead, publisher and developer Saber Interactive confirmed it was a story-driven, first-person horror adventure. Read more

item.title: Reanimal review
item.description: It's impossible to talk about Reanimal without talking about Little Nightmares. Developer Tarsier's first game since departing the series that put it on the map (part three was handled elsewhere with middling results) is so Little Nightmares coded it's difficult to ignore. item.description: Subnautica 2's development has been anything but peaceful, but it's still set to arrive later this year. Meanwhile, Krafton is planning to keep veterans and newcomers alike busy with Nintendo Switch 2 ports of the two previous games. Read more

item.title: The Diablo warlock rumours are true, but the new class is coming to three games, including to Diablo 2 today
item.description: The dataminers were right, there is a warlock class coming to Diablo 4, as part of the The Lord of Hatred expansion that arrives in April. I played it at Blizzard a couple of weeks ago, and although I can't tell you in detail about it yet, I can say it's the dark complement to the light-bringing paladin class that's also in Lord of Hatred - the yin to its yang, if you like. Read more
